newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the U.S. dollar and sterling but was trading firmer on the mark and the rand at the close of Tuesday's fairly brisk interbank session, dealers said.

"We saw a fair amount of two-way trade and that's what mainly drove the (exchange) rates today," one dealer said, adding that although the central Reserve Bank intervened to buy foreign currency off the market, this did not have much of an impact.

The local unit finished the day at 11.3825/3925 on the U.S. dollar, marginally weaker from Monday's 11.3800/3900 and was at 19.2360/2590 from 19.1595/1890 versus sterling, largely due to a softer U.S. dollar overseas.
It however gained on the mark to 6.4870/4940 from 6.5240/5280 and was also a touch firmer at 2.5020/5060 versus South Africa's rand compared to 2.5090/5100.
